item.title: After the floods, Nepal's survivors look to rebuilding their lives
item.description: In Nepal, after the deadly flood, another ordeal begins for the survivors: finding shelter, food, and simply the means to survive. In the devastated villages, families lost everything in minutes. And while rescue workers continue searching for possible survivors, those who escaped the disaster are trying to rebuild their lives, despite the threat of another flood. FRANCE 24's special correspondents visited Sinchaur, in the Nuwako district, one of the villages hit by the flood of August 26. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Relentless heat worsens Gaza's ongoing struggle to access water
item.description: In Gaza, securing drinking water is a relentless daily struggle. The war with Israel has destroyed critical water and sanitation infrastructure, and as temperatures soar, the extreme heat is escalating an already severe shortage into a deadly humanitarian crisis. Two and a half years of war with Israel have damaged or destroyed nearly 90% of Gaza’s water and sanitation infrastructure according to UNICEF. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.description: In the US, a flash flood in the Grand Canyon National Park over the weekend forced the evacuation of dozens of people and left some 15 people missing.
